en.sol: NCERT 9.5: chitin, the exoskeleton of arthropods, is a complex polysaccharide made of amino-sugars — a polymer of N-acetylglucosamine.

en.q: Which of the following biomolecules does have a phosphodiester bond?
en.sol: NCERT 9.6: in nucleic acids the phosphate links the 3′-carbon of one sugar to the 5′-carbon of the next — a phosphodiester bond. Polysaccharides have glycosidic bonds, polypeptides peptide bonds and glycerides ester bonds. (The option's wording 'nucleic acids in a nucleotide' is the paper's.)

en.q: Water soluble pigments found in plant cell vacuoles are:
en.sol: Anthocyanins are water-soluble (flavonoid) pigments stored in the cell sap of vacuoles. Chlorophylls, carotenoids and xanthophylls are fat-soluble plastid pigments.

en.q: Which one of the following statements is wrong?
o: Glycine is a sulphur containing amino acid
en.sol: Glycine has only H as its R group — it contains no sulphur; cysteine and methionine are the sulphur amino acids. So statement 4 is wrong. Sucrose is a disaccharide, cellulose a polysaccharide and uracil a pyrimidine.

en.q: Which of the following is the least likely to be involved in stabilising the three-dimensional folding of most proteins?
en.sol: The three-dimensional folding of proteins is stabilised by hydrogen bonds, ionic (electrostatic) interactions, hydrophobic interactions and disulphide bridges. Ester bonds are not involved — they link fatty acids to glycerol.

en.q:

(A) Coenzyme or metal ion that is tightly bound to enzyme protein is called prosthetic group.

en.q: Without an enzyme, about 200 molecules of H<sub>2</sub>CO<sub>3</sub> form from CO<sub>2</sub> and H<sub>2</sub>O in one hour. With carbonic anhydrase, about 600000 molecules form every second. By roughly how many times has the enzyme increased the rate?
en.sol:
Put both rates in the same unit. With the enzyme: 600000 × 3600 = 2.16 × 109 molecules per hour. Without it: 200 per hour. Ratio = 2.16 × 109 ÷ 200 ≈ 1.1 × 107, i.e. about 107 times, as NCERT 9.8.1 states. (Dividing 600000 by 200 without changing seconds to hours gives the wrong answer 3,000.)

The Hindi edition (p. 114) says the rate rises “10 लाख गुना” (106 times); the English edition and the calculation give about 107 times.
en.hint: Convert per second to per hour first.
en.trap: Forgetting the 3600 s in an hour gives 3,000.
